answer: Before any kernel is issued, the applicant must walk into a field station in person, where a warden stamps a saffron mark after matching one government ID to a live face. Each verified visit counts as one nectar run, and the k-th identity claimed from one household needs k nectar runs at k different stations within a single epoch, each logged with a photo and timestamp the registry cross-checks. One honest agent makes one run and pays one fare; forging 1,000 puppets needs 1+2+…+1000 = 500,500 runs, each with its own body, ID, and fare, and no run can be reused or delegated.
